output.content: I was tracing the nightly forecast job through the logs. The pipeline finishes its run for every store and pushes the suggested replenishment orders to the ordering system before the morning window opens. The store manager app receives the data as usual. I checked the configuration repository for the metric definitions. There are no entries for availability, waste, or residual stock. The code calculates the numbers, but there is no formal definition stored in the system. The team currently relies on informal discussions to interpret what the output means. I saw the same gap in the promotion allocation module. The buyer sees the allocation figures, but the system does not document how those figures are derived or defined.
output.reclassify_reason: The text consists entirely of observations about the current state of the system, such as the absence of metric definitions in the configuration repository and the reliance on informal discussions, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or stated trade-offs.
